scope: Windows 11 x64 build 26300, native desktop with a separate identifier, disposable directories, and loopback SSH/model services
before: The previous native desktop offered the local New folder here command while a browser tab was selected after visiting a local folder.
Force-terminating the earlier fixture left its PowerShell and console host alive under the exited desktop PID; the console host still held its unique temporary working directory.
observations: New local tabs from web/SSH opened This PC. Creating a folder tab from local PowerShell selected its starting directory and Agent followed that directory. Context menus on background tabs used the clicked tab.

A missing main directory survived a normal exit and restart with its address selected. Retry after creating the directory produced a readable listing and did not duplicate history. An actual New folder appeared only in that directory.

A missing companion directory cleared its previous rows and disabled transfers. Refresh of that pane opened the requested location after it became available; the Agent work directory stayed on the left.
Deferred create and directory-list tests moved the foreground before each completion and verified that the destination, search filter and inline rename did not move to the other tab.

The final fixture recorded the live PowerShell PID, started an independent marker writer, and received the system OpenSSH client's banner on a loopback socket. Forced desktop exit ended that exact shell PID and closed the socket. The independent program completed after the host exited.

tests.nativeDesktop: tools/verify_harness_desktop.ps1, including file tab scope, mixed restore, pinned projects, model switch, archive/exit recovery and M1 through M4
